_comment: Recommended follow-up actions by incident type. Code picks these; the model never writes a procedure. Editable at review. Wording is ours, generic workplace practice, not taken from any one standard.
water_leak: Find and repair the source of the leak
Check nearby electrical points for water exposure
Dry the area and check for damage
fire_smoke: Have the fire safety officer inspect the area
Check and recharge any extinguisher that was used
Inspect the equipment that caused it before reuse
electrical: Isolate the circuit until an electrician inspects it
Review the inspection record for the circuit
injury: Make sure first aid or medical care was given
Inform the safety officer and the person's manager
Investigate the cause and record it
slip_trip_fall: Check lighting and floor condition in the area
Make sure first aid was offered
equipment_failure: Tag the equipment out of service
Check whether similar equipment is affected
chemical_spill: Contain and clean up with the spill kit, following the safety data sheet
security: Review access logs and camera footage
Secure the affected area or asset
near_miss: Share the lesson with the team
other: Review the incident with the safety officer
